### 🌐 English only
- The game now ships in English only. The language switch in Settings is gone until a second language is added.
- The trader's spoken greeting is in English.

### ⌨️ Hotbar keys
- Weapon slots now default to the number keys **1–5** instead of the Czech-layout characters (+ ě š č ř). Existing installs are moved to the digits automatically.
- On a Czech keyboard layout, rebind the five slots in Settings → Controls to get the old keys back.
